title: Discovery and translation of the Necronomicon manuscript

tellings.quote: I said, "This looks like it says necronomicon."

plain: An author named Peter Levenda says that in the 1970s, at the Warlock Shop in Brooklyn Heights, New York, linked to a man named Herman Slater, he looked at an old manuscript and said, "This looks like it says Necronomicon," the name of a legendary book of magic. He tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that the translation was finished on October 12, 1975. In his telling, this is how a book many thought was only legend came into print.
